executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile the Event-Space Story and Establish the Canonical Hotel Domain
executiveSummary.lead: Waterstone has meaningful reach—53.5% consideration and 76.6% scenario presence—but ranks fifth among six Hilton Honors peers. Its active site presents a commercially useful marina, dining, and meetings offer; the immediate quality risk is that trusted sources publish materially different event-space totals while the historically used domain does not reliably lead research to that active offer.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared; Certified Peer Position compares only the certified six-hotel set. Presence does not equal bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Two Verified Meeting Figures Need Hotel Reconciliation
themes.what: waterstoneboca.com repeatedly states 18,899 square feet of meeting space (five spaces; 220-plus guests). A previously cited Hilton Curio listing figure (~7,500 sq ft / ballroom 225) could not be re-verified in this recovery because the Hilton property URL returned a brand error page under HTTP and browser checks—so that brand figure is not used as current customer-facing evidence.
themes.whyItMatters: Do not select a winner. The difference may be indoor versus indoor-plus-outdoor, flexible versus total, or an outdated Hilton record; events leadership must confirm definitions first.

themes.title: Canonical Domain Control Is a High-Priority Investigation
themes.what: waterstoneboca.com identifies itself as the Official Site and its accessibility statement names www.waterstoneboca.com, while the historically used waterstoneresort.com failed, timed out, or served non-hotel content during research.
themes.whyItMatters: Management should confirm ownership, canonical tags, redirects, booking paths, and partner links before changing infrastructure or describing either domain as universally broken.

themes.title: The Active Site Already Carries Commercial Strength
themes.what: The working site presents SeaSpray and Kasumi dining, marina access, rooms, and detailed meeting content, while Hilton supplies a trusted Curio profile.
themes.whyItMatters: After facts and domain control are settled, the agency can align a distinctive waterfront resort story across trusted channels without inventing a new proposition.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The hotel has a signed event-space schedule, a documented canonical-domain decision, approved redirect behavior, and consistent active-site and Hilton facts.
executiveSummary.closing: Waterstone’s active digital offer is commercially credible; the fastest quality gain is to remove ambiguity. Define exactly what 7,500-plus and 18,899 square feet each count, then make waterstoneboca.com and every trusted partner path point to the same approved resort story. Digital authority: Local leisure guides already mention Waterstone’s marina dock partner and on-site SeaSpray dining—useful verified external mentions. Digital content readiness: Waterstone’s hotel-operated site (waterstoneboca.

actions.headline: Establish One Approved Meeting-Space Source of Truth
actions.priorityWhy: Two trusted guest-facing sources publish materially different meeting-space totals.
actions.whatWeFound: Hilton states over 7,500 square feet of flexible meeting space and ballroom capacity up to 225. The active hotel page repeatedly states 18,899 square feet, five different spaces, and accommodation for 220-plus guests.
actions.whyItMatters: Both claims are verified, but their scopes are not. They may describe indoor versus indoor-plus-outdoor, flexible versus total, or an outdated Hilton record. The hotel—not the audit—must reconcile the definitions before correction.
recommendedSteps: Events leadership defines total indoor, outdoor, flexible, and ballroom space.
Document whether each published number uses a different scope.
Approve one source-of-truth table.
Submit precise corrections to Hilton and/or the active site.
actions.supportingParties: Hotel GM; Hilton content support; digital agency
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Confirmation in 1 week; corrections within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.
